meta.title: Care Companion — travel buddy
meta.description: Find a companion for hospital visits, the bank, government offices, or errands. Not a medical service.

landing.headline: Out on errands, with a friend beside you
landing.sub: Pick someone free at your time and in your area. Agree on pay between yourselves, outside the app.
landing.orbitBody: Hospital, bank, government office, shopping — spin through the jobs companions take.
landing.painBody: Appointments, banks, government queues, paperwork — you need someone to go with you, not a clinician.
landing.how1Body: Type, date, time, origin, destination, and the fee you offer.
landing.how2Body: We suggest people who match area and time, or you browse the list.
landing.how3Body: They accept, you chat, finish the trip, and leave a rating.
landing.disclaimer: Care Companion is travel and errand assistance only. It is not medical care or patient caregiving.
